body_markdown:
GARLAND, TX (Jun 16, 2026) — Massimo has confirmed purchase orders from the U.S. Department of Defense and the U.S. Army. The vehicles will support facility operations, maintenance, logistics movement and day-to-day fleet activities.


Massimo's Fleet Department serves government, military, municipal, institutional, utility, public works and commercial fleets, with vehicles ranging from value-oriented utility models to premium HVAC-equipped models in gas and electric versions.


"Our confirmed purchase orders from the Department of Defense and the U.S. Army represent an important milestone for Massimo's expanding fleet business," said Quenton Petersen, CEO of Massimo Group. "These orders demonstrate the practical value of Massimo vehicles in operational environments where durability, versatility and cost efficiency are critical."
